content: Google also changed how third-party email clients log into Gmail. This requires changing two settings in Thunderbird to fix. First, go to Account Settings -> your email address -> Edit outgoing server... and change "Authentication method" from "Normal password" to "OAuth2" and click OK. Next, click on "Server Settings" under your email address and also change "Authentication method" from "Normal password" to "OAuth2". Finally, restart Thunderbird. A window should pop up with Google's log in page that also has the Thunderbird logo. Log into Google like normal and Thunderbird should be able to access your Gmail again.
